maya-cs: Heads up — prepping QBR for Nebula next Wed. Need final token econ + 90d spend runway, plus an enablement plan for their ML infra team. Who can own the forecast and a short enablement deck?

jonah-finops: I can do the 90d forecast + delta vs commit, will pull daily token trends. Give me a sample of their traffic (top endpoints) and I'll have EOD. :+1:

akshay-se: I can draft a runbook & incident play for burst behavior. @maya-cs send the prompt families and any recent spike timestamps.

budget-alerts-bot: :warning: projection: Nebula retainer utilization expected to reach 85% in ~10 days based on current trend (lookback=14d).

maya-cs: Good catch, bot. Please pin that alert to the prep doc and add a suggested top-up ask. Also add a "burst cap" ask and a fallback model policy for latency incidents.

jonah-finops: Quick snapshot I pulled (rough):
```
current_month_tokens: 23,450,000
avg_tokens_per_day: 780,000
7d_trend: +12%
projected_90d_burn: 210,000,000
commit_remaining: 65,000,000
recommended_topup: 40,000,000 (15% buffer)
```
I'll convert this into a slide and attach margins/scenario table.

akshay-se: I'll schedule a 30m enablement + runbook walk. Tentative Tue 10am PT. Will include fallback run to `redwood-small` and KV-cache tuning notes.

tara-cs: I can build the enablement slides / demo. Quick Q: which model variant are they currently on? Llama-2-70b or redwood-v1? Need to tailor the demo.

maya-cs: They're on `open-70b-quant` in production, with automatic fallback to `redwood-small-v1` for latency-sensitive endpoints.

jonah-finops: Plan: final forecast + ask for top-up + scenario table (conservative/likely/optimistic). I'll include a repayment schedule and bullets for finance to approve retainer increase.

maya-cs: Action list: jonah-finops -> final forecast + slide (due EOD today). akshay-se -> runbook + schedule demo (confirm attendee list). tara-cs -> slides + 30m demo. maya-cs -> QBR deck + customer context + renewal risk notes.

maya-cs: Ping this thread with attachments (forecast slide, alert screenshot, runbook) once ready. Thanks team :rocket:
